correctness.rationale: Source RESULT.md defines the Pappus incidence graph on P(x,y), L(m,b) in F_3, y=mx+b, with point distances 2 versus 4 by vertical class and analogous slope classes; opposite part distances 1 or 3. The two-point/two-line necessity follows incidence-word pigeonhole, missing-slope argument and intersection class; sufficiency separately distinguishes all point and line vertices. Independent Python reimplemented the 18-vertex graph, all-pair shortest paths, 153 distinguishing masks and ALL 2^18=262144 subsets; the 216 four-subset geometric matches coincide exactly with resolution. Independent tallies gave 243834 resolving subsets, exact coefficient sequence as stated, and 108/108 bases distinguished by 0/1 induced incidence edges. The written affine incidence group and duality give the orbit statement; no extrapolation to other q. Metric dimension 4 already known.
